rationale: Provisional headroom pending the first cross-platform CI run for issue #37 (macOS arm64 clang, macOS Intel clang, Windows x86_64 MSVC). These are placeholder upper bounds reasoned from this repository's existing single-machine cross-precision tolerances (tests/test_diffusion_analyzer_cli.py: 2e-7 relative for float32, 1e-14 for float64) loosened by roughly two orders of magnitude to leave room for compiler/architecture-driven summation-order differences on the compact Reference impulse tracer. They are replaced with tight, measured values plus real observed headroom once CI evidence from all three platforms has been reviewed -- see docs/adr/0001-cross-platform-reproducibility.md.

energyRelativeError.rationale: Provisional: ~50x the single-machine float32 energy tolerance.

orthogonalityMaximumAbsoluteError.rationale: Provisional headroom above float32 machine epsilon accumulation for an 8x8 Hadamard matrix.

correlationMeanAbsoluteOffDiagonal.rationale: Provisional: correlation is a normalized zero-lag dot product, same order as orthogonality error.

alignmentMinimum.rationale: Alignment is a Jaccard overlap of active-frame sets on a tiny, well-separated tracer; expected to be exactly reproducible unless a sample sits near the -120 dB activity floor.

colorationPeakToPeakDb.rationale: Provisional: dB-scale metric, loosened for cross-platform FFT accumulation-order differences.

colorationSpectralFlatness.rationale: Provisional, same basis as correlation/orthogonality metrics.

densityCount.rationale: Measured Distinct-arrival counts (total and per-bin) on the compact Reference impulse tracer sit far above the -120 dB activity floor, so no sample is expected to cross the floor differently across platforms; committed at zero pending contrary CI evidence rather than assumed structural.
